tei:div.tei:p: "$ (489)༄༅// dge ldan bka' brgyud rin po che'i phyag chen rtsa ba rgyal ba'i gzhung lam

zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (490)༄༅// na mo ma hā mu drā ya/ kun khyab kun gyi rang bzhin phyag rgya che// dbyer med brjod bral sems kyi rdo rje'i dbyings// rjen par ston mdzad khyab bdag grub pa'i rje// zla med bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud// mdo rgyud man ngag rgya mtsho'i bcud bsdus nas// legs par 'dom mdzad dge ldan bka' brgyud pa// grub mchog badz+ra yab sras kyi// bka' srol phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa bri// 'di la sbyor dngos mjug gsum las// dang po bstan dang theg chen la// 'jug pa'i sgo dang gzhung shing phyir// kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin pa'i// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nan tan bya// sems kyi chos nyid mthong ba yang*// tshogs bsags sgrib sbyang la bltos pas// yig brgya 'bum tsam ltung bshags ni// brgya phyag gang mang sngon btang nas// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// snying nas gsol 'debs yang yang bya// dngos gzhi phyag rgya chen po la// bzhed tshul mang du 'dug na yang*// (491)mdo sngags dbye bas gnyis su yod// phyi ma rdo rje'i lus nyid la// gnad du bsnun sogs thabs mkhas las// byung ba'i bde chen 'od gsal te// sa ra ha dang klu sgrub zhabs// na ro me tri'i phyag chen te// grub snying skor nas bstan pa yi// bla med rgyud sde'i yang snying yin// sngon ma rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyis// dngos bstan stong nyid bsgom tshul te// 'di las gzhan pa'i thar pa'i lam// med ces 'phags mchog klu sgrub gsung*// 'dir ni de yi dgongs pa bzhin// phyag rgya chen po'i khrid phog ste// sems kyi ngo sprod byed pa'i tshul// rgyud ldan bla ma'i gsung bzhin brjod// lhan cig skyes sbyor ga'u ma// lnga ldan ro snyoms yi ge bzhi// zhi byed gcod yul rdzogs chen dang*// dbu ma'i lta khrid la sogs pa// so sor ming 'dogs mang na yang*// nges don lung rigs la mkhas shing*// nyams myong can gyi rnal 'byor pas// dpyad na dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab// des na 'di la lta thog nas// sgom pa 'tshol dang sgom thog (492)nas// lta ba 'tshol ba'i lugs gnyis las// 'dir ni phyi ma'i lugs bzhin yin// bsam gtan bde ba'i stegs bu la// lus gnad bdun dang ldan byas la// rlung ro dgu phrugs dag tu bsal// rig pa dwangs snyigs legs par phye// rnam dag dge ba'i sems ldan pas// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*// zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom// shugs drag gsol 'debs brgya rtsa sogs// byas nas bla ma rang la bstim// snang ba ban bun ngang de la// re dogs la sogs rnam rtog gis// bcas bcos gang yang mi byed pa// g.yo med cung zad mnyam par gzhog

/brgyal dang gnyid log lta bu yi// yid byed bkag pa ma yin pa// ma yengs dran pa'i rgyang so tshugs// 'gyu ba rig pa'i shes bzhin sdogs// rig cing gsal ba'i ngo bo la// hrim gyis bsgrims la gcer gyis ltos// rnam rtog gang dang gar skyes pa// de dang de nyid ngos zin bya// yang na ral bskor mkhan bzhin du// rnam rtog ci skyes rbad rbad gcod// bcad mthar gnas pa de yi tshe// dran pa ma shor lhod kyis glod// hrim gyis bsgrims la lhod kyis glod// sems kyis 'jog pa de na gda'// zhes dang gzhan yang ji skad du// 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid ni// glod na grol ba the tshom med// ces gsungs pa ltar ma yengs glod// rnam rtog gang skyes ngo bo la// bltas tshe rang yal stong sang 'char// de bzhin gnas tshe'ang brtags pa na// ma bsgrib stong gsal hrig ge ba// mthong ba gnas 'gyu 'dres pa zhes// grags shing rnam rtog ci skyes kyang*// mi 'gog 'gyu ba ngos zin par// byas te de yi ngo bo la// 'jog pa rdzings kyi bya brtson ni// 'phur ba'i dpe dang mtshungs pa yin// ji ltar gzings nas 'phur ba'i bya rog ni// (493)phyogs rnams bskor nas slar yang der 'bab bzhin// zhes pa ji bzhin bskyangs pa las// mnyam gzhag ngo bo gang gis kyang*// ma sgribs dwangs shing gsal ba dang*// gzugs can gang du ma grub pas// stong sang nam mkha' lta bu dang*// ci yang 'char bas hrig ge ba// de ltar sems kyi chos nyid ni// mngon sum lhag gis mthong mod kyang*// 'di zhes gzung zhing bstan du med// gang shar 'dzin med lhug par 'jog /'di ni sangs rgyas sbar bcangs su// gtod pa'i gdams ngag yin no zhes// deng sang gangs ri'i sgom chen pa// phal cher dgongs pa gcig gis sgrog /de ltar mod kyi tshul 'di ni// dang po'i las can sems gnas pa// bsgrub pa'i rmad byung thabs mkhas dang*// sems kyi kun rdzob ngo sprod tshul// yin zhes chos kyi rgyal mtshan smra// da ni sems kyi chos nyid la// ngo sprod ji ltar bya ba'i tshul// sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kun// ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul bzung dang*// bdag blo rmongs pa'i mun sel ba'i// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal gdams 'god// sngar gyi mnyam gzhag ngang nyid las// ma g.yos dwangs pa'i chu nang du// ji ltar nye'u chung 'khyug pa ltar// phra mo'i shes pas sgom pa po'i// skyes bus rang bzhin mdzangs par brtag

/'phags pa klu sgrub skyob nyid kyis// skyes bu sa min chu ma yin// me min rlung min nam mkha' min// rnam shes ma yin kun min na// de las gzhan na skyes bu gang*// skyes bu khams drug 'das pa'i phyir// yang dag ma yin ji lta bar// de bzhin khams ni re re yang*// 'dus phyir yang dag nyid du min// gsungs pa ji bzhin btsal ba na// mnyam bzhag mnyam par 'jog mkhan sogs// rdul phran tsam yang ma rnyed (494)pa// de tshe g.yeng med rtse gcig tu// nam mkha' lta bu'i mnyam bzhag skyong*// yang na mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang*// gzugs su ma grub stong sang nge*// sgrib med sna tshogs 'char shing 'phro// 'gag med gsal zhing rig pa'i rgyun// chad pa med pa 'jug pa'i sems// ltos med snang zhing 'dzin pa yi// zhen yul mgon po zhi ba lhas// rgyud dang tshogs zhes bya ba ni// phreng ba dmag sogs bzhin du brdzun// zhes gsungs lung dang rig pa yis// snang tshul ltar du ma grub pa'i// ngang du rtse gcig mnyam par gzhog /mdor na bdag gi dge ba'i bshes// don dang mthun pa'i thams cad mkhyen// sangs rgyas ye shes zhal snga nas// gar shar rnam rtog 'dzin par yang rig na// don dam chos dbyings gzhan la ltos med 'char// shar ba'i ngang du rig pa zhugs pa la// rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog pa e ma ho// zhes gsungs de bzhin dam pas kyang*// stong pa'i ngang du rig pa'i mdung bskor bya// lta ba la thogs thug med do ding ri ba// zhes sogs dgong pa gcig tu gnas// rjes ni phyag chen bsgom pa las// byung ba'i rnam dkar ci mchis pa// dus gsum dge tshogs rgya mtshor bcas// bla med byang chub chen por bsngo// de ltar goms nas tshogs drug gis// yul du snang ba ci shar yang*// snang tshul zhib mor rtog shig dang*// gnas tshul rjen par lhang gis 'char// gang shar ngos 'dzin lta bu'i gnad// mdor na rang sems la sogs pa// gang gang snang ba'i don de ni// ma 'dzin de de'i gnas tshul de// nges par gyis la rtag tu skyong*// 'di ltar shes nas 'khor 'das kyi// chos kun rang bzhin gcig tu sbyor// de skad du yang 'phags pa lhas// dngos po (495)gcig gi lta so gang*// de ni kun gyi lta sor bshad// gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa// de ni kun gyi stong nyid yin// ces gsungs de ltar chos nyid la// tshul bzhin mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngor// yod med la sogs 'khor 'das kyi// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral med kyi// de las langs nas brtag pa'i tshe// ming kyang btags yod tsam zhig gi

bya byed rten 'brel bsnyon med par// rmi lam smig rgyu chu zla dang*// sgyu mar lta bur ngang gis 'char// snang bas stong pa mi bsgrib cing*// stong pas snang ba mi 'gog pa// stong dang rten 'byung don gcig pa'i// lam bzang de tshe mngon sum 'gyur// de skad smra ba mang thos spong ba pa// blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ste// dge bas 'gro kun zhi sgo gnyis pa dang*// bral ba'i lam 'dis myur du rgyal gyur cig /ces phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod byed tshul 'di yang*/ 'di nang gi chos brgyad smyon pa'i zlos gar ltar mthong nas/ dben pa'i ri sul du drang srong gi spyod tshul gyis 'dug nas/ lam 'di la nyams len snying por byed pa gnas bcu rab 'byams pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan dang ha mthong ka bcu pa shes rab seng ge gnyis kyis snga mo nas yang yang bskul zhing*/ gzhan yang nges don phyag chen gyi nyams len byed par 'dod pa'i rang gi slob ma mang pos bskul ba dang*// khyad par rje grub pa'i dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal ba dben sa pa chen po de nyid kyis rang gzhan la 'doms par mdzad pa'i nyams 'gur zhig tu bshes gnyen bsten tshul zhi lhag gi bar bka' gdams lam rim ltar gdams nas/ mjug tu bshad ma thag pa'i lam 'di ma yin pa// da lta'i gangs can sa la ma grags pa'i// phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag mthar thug pa// (496)da lta yi ger 'god par mi nus so// zhes de dus dgag bya'i dbang gis mi 'god pa phyi dus la dgongs pa/ dper na dam chos pad dkar du// sangs rgyas ye shes rab tu rtogs bya'i phyir// thabs 'di rang byung gis ni mdzad gyur gyi// de dag rnams la khyed cag sangs rgyas su// 'gyur ro zhes ni nam yang mi gsung ngo*// ci phyir zhe na skyob pa dus la gzigs// zhes gsung pa dang 'dra ba'i bzhed pa bsgrub pa'i phyir// ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po nas bzung ste/

bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi zhal snga nas kyi bar/ lam 'di mngon sum du thugs nyams su bstar ba'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams shing*/ dam tshig la sel ma zhugs pa'i rigs su byung zhing mdo rgyud dam pa'i man ngag 'dzin pa'i spong ba pa bla bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du sbyar ba'o// phyag chen brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni// na mo ma hā mu drā ye// lhun grub sku gsum gyi gzhal yas su// dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas rigs kun gtso// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang*// byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang*// lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi// mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhing rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gyi rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yab// mkhyen rab 'phags pa 'jam dpal la gsol ba 'debs// rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang*// byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang*// lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi// mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs// yul byang phyogs kha ba can ljongs 'dir// thub bstan la thub dbang gnyis pa'i rje// rje btsun blo bzang (497)grags pa la gsol ba 'debs// rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang*// byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang*// lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi// mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs// 'jam dbyangs kyi sras po tsong kha pa'i// sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gtso// rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs// rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang*// byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang*// lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi// mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs// snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa'i mdzod phye nas// skal ldan gyi gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i// ba po chos kyi rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang*// byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang*// lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi// mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs// rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin nas// 'chi med kyi rig 'dzin sku brnyes pa'i// grub mchog dharma badz+ra la gsol ba 'debs// rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang*// byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang*// lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi// mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs// chos brgyad kyi 'ching bas ma gos par// nges don gyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// blo bzang don yod grub pa la gsol ba 'debs// rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang*// byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang*// lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi// mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum gyi pho brang nyams dga' bar// ngur smrig gi gar gyis 'gro kun 'dren// mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes la gsol ba 'debs// (498)rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang*// byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang*// lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi// mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs// rje grub thob gong ma'i gdan sa ru// dad ldan gyi gdul bya'i dpal du shar// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang*// byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang*// lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi// mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs// rje bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba dang*// gnas 'khor ba la zhen pa log pa dang*// ma 'gro kun sgrol ba'i khur khyer nas// lam thun mongs dang thun mong ma yin pa'i// dpal zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po de// dus myur du thob bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang dge slong blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis smras so// sarba maṅga lam/// /
